title: HVAC Preventive Maintenance Work Order Form
subtitle: Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance: connects authorized scope to results.
description: HVAC Preventive Maintenance Work Order Form covers air handler, condenser, controls, distribution, and served zone. The facility maintenance coordinator records Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance authorized tasks, materials, results, and changes. HVAC Preventive Maintenance Work Order Form keeps Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance exceptions visible until the facility maintenance coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use HVAC Preventive Maintenance Work Order Form at equipment room, roof, mechanical area, and occupied zone. Document air handler, condenser, controls, distribution, and served zone identity before Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance begins. Compare air handler, condenser, controls, distribution, and served zone findings with stated Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance criteria; route unresolved Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance issues to qualified HVAC service supervisor. For HVAC Preventive Maintenance Work Order Form, confirm requirements for Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance. Ask qualified HVAC service supervisor to review Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance conditions beyond the facility maintenance coordinator's role.

sections.title: Authorized work observations and evidence
sections.guidance: Record authorized Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance activity; separate proposed, declined, deferred, or new Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance scope.

blocks.label: Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance work and verification points
items: Belt, bearing, fan, and motor condition
Supply and return temperature or airflow result
Coil, drain pan, trap, and condensate condition
Refrigerant-circuit visual condition and leak concern
Thermostat, sensor, alarm, and sequence response
blocks.guidance: Use each Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance check to prompt documented air handler, condenser, controls, distribution, and served zone execution; enter its actual Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance result in the table.

sections.title: Work exception and scope changes
sections.guidance: Stop Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance at any scope or cost limit; honor facility maintenance coordinator access and safety boundaries.

blocks.label: Do not proceed without control
blocks.guidance: Stop normal processing when energy isolation, refrigerant concern, combustion concern, or failed operating safeguard remains unresolved. Protect air handler, condenser, controls, distribution, and served zone; document the Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance notification and await qualified HVAC service supervisor direction.

blocks.label: Conditions requiring stop or renewed authorization
items: Refrigerant or combustion concern outside authorization
Blocked drainage or active water damage
Required capacity, alarm, or sequence not restored
blocks.guidance: For Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance, identify affected air handler, condenser, controls, distribution, and served zone scope; ask facility maintenance coordinator to document the Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance immediate control before continuing.
